text:
sam: FYI noticed a cluster of "provisional balance" anomalies after the EU canary yesterday. Looks like resumptions after a routing fallback leave provisional tokens orphaned when a toolcall is truncated mid-stream. cc @maria @alex

maria: can you paste an example ledger line? want to see how it surfaces in billing rows

sam: simplified ledger snippet:
```json
{"id":"sess-zz9","route":"eu-canary-1","provisional_tokens":38,"status":"orphaned","note":"fallback-resume"}
{"id":"sess-zz9.resume","route":"eu-canary-2","provisional_tokens":0,"confirmed_tokens":0}
```

alex: so the resume path created a new session id with `.resume` suffix and the old one is left in an orphaned state. Reconciler only joins on exact session id so it doesn't clean up.

chris: root cause: mid-request toolcall truncated -> router drops lease on upstream host -> runtime emits a handoff, session gets tombstoned locally but we never emit a final refund/confirm. Billing machinery assumes either confirm or refund; neither happened.

sam: observed pattern across 3 clusters, but concentrated on canary route. impact: small per-instance cost but noisy in daily billing totals and some customers flagging unexplained deltas.

maria: potential fixes (ranked):
- E1: Emit a structured "session.alias" event on handoff containing orig_session_id+new_session_id. Minimal API change, downstream reconciler can map chains.
- E2: Add parent_session_id to SessionCreate so the chain is explicit in the session record (more invasive).
- E3: Automatic provisional TTL: reconciler auto-refunds provisional tokens after X minutes unless a confirm arrives (fastest to ship, but could mask legit late confirms).

alex: leaning to E1 as lowest friction. we can add an event type without changing SessionCreate. reconciler can subscribe and merge provisional balances into the new session or perform refunds where appropriate.

chris: pros/cons: E1 preserves normal routing behavior and keeps scaling intact. E3 is tempting but risky (may refund valid but slow confirms). E2 helps long-term for tracing but touches too many services before next release.

sam: telemetry requests:
- counter: `streaming.tombstones.total{route,cluster,model}`
- gauge: `streaming.tombstones.provisional_balance` (sum of provisional tokens stuck)
- alert: cluster-level if tombstones.total > 50 in 5m OR provisional_balance > 500 tokens
- add a per-route canary gate: fail canary if tombstones.total/cluster_rate > 0.1%

maria: console UX request: show a new view under Billing -> Session anomalies that lists orphaned sessions, provisional balance, and one-click reconcile. Also an opt-in toggle for including provisional anomalies in daily summaries (default off).

alex: dev plan: I'll prototype the session.alias event and a reconciler consumer that does: 1) link chains 2) attempt to reconcile (confirm vs refund) based on downstream acks 3) mark reconciled in ledger. I'll open PRs for reconciler + router event emission.

chris: tests: add integration test that simulates a toolcall truncate -> handoff -> resume with new id, assert reconciler receives alias event and final ledger state has no leftover provisional. Also unit tests for TTL refund fallback.

maria: I'll do the console change + update the billing runbook to include manual reconcile steps and a How-To for Customer Support.

sam: deploy gating: if we see >50 tombstones in 5m in canary, auto-fail the rollout and alert #oncall. I'll add the dashboard panel and an OKR to reduce orphaned provisional balance by 90% this quarter.

deploy-bot: canary report: EU clusters: 1/3 failed health check (not infra), reason: session-resume anomalies detected by heuristics. Investigate before promoting.

alex: grabbing owner for reconciler PR. chris you can own tests, sam the dashboard, maria console+runbook. I'll push a draft event schema today:
```json
{"event_type":"session.alias","orig_id":"sess-zz9","new_id":"sess-zz9.resume","reason":"handoff-toolcall-truncate","timestamp":1771000005}
```

chris: important note: reconciler must be idempotent and tolerant of events arriving out-of-order. Also we should record a reconciliation provenance row so billing audits can follow decisions.

maria: agree. Also add a small UX affordance to surface the reconciler logs link per session.

sam: OK moving to #incident/token-orphans-1771000001 for live debugging and to track follow-up tickets. Thanks everyone.
